ja163:1.1: These black creatures, who are white tusked, are yours,
ja163:1.2: Over a hundred, covered over with gold,
ja163:1.3: ‘I give these to you,’ said (king) Susīma,
ja163:1.4: In remembrance of my dead ancestors.
